decisions.reason: Locates partial (B2), runningCalls (B3), turnEnds (B4) reads; explains ChatSnapshot.legacy projection for the first two and correctly switches turnEnds reason to the chat timeline turn/end payload, including views.chat access coordinates.
B6 keeps useSession(s => s.running) on the SessionSnapshot lifecycle seat, explicitly unchanged, and never claims the call must be renamed.

Repoints the ConversationSnapshot import to dsh-client-ui-conversation, but claims the package.json dsh-client-runtime inject entry 'stands' and only tentatively notes a later cordis re-export instead of removing the entry and repointing ClientContext to scoped cordis, contradicting the required migration.

Mentions the scoped slots.register call, the inject service list, and the declare-module merge as unchanged, but does not explain slots.inject around registration, ui-renderer/client Context augmentation ownership, or slot lifetime.

Ties changes to fully described DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 (turn timeline) and clearly separates projection-first fields from immediate changes (B4, B1/B5/B7); each card ID carries substantive explanation, not a bare ID.
